title: Cobble X Friends
description: Welcome to our Cobblemon modpack — a chill adventure built for playing with friends, exploring together, and making unforgettable moments. Catch and train Pokémon, build awesome bases, battle each other, trade rare finds, and go on group adventures across
body:
Hey everyone! We just launched a brand new Cobblemon modpack built specifically for us to hang out, team up, and cause a little bit of chaos.

We have a massive new world with custom biomes to explore and hidden secrets to discover together, complete with split loot so everyone gets a fair share of the treasure. Advanced building tools and custom furniture mean we can build massive cities, detailed trainer hubs, and cozy homes exactly the way we want them. You can also earn coins from daily bounties and open up vending machines to sell your extra items or rare Pokémon to the rest of the group. Plus, proximity voice chat means no more sitting in one massive Discord call—you can whisper, plan pranks, or hear someone scream from across a cave in real-time.

It doesn't matter if you're a hardcore competitive battler, a cozy farmer, or a master builder—there is a place for you here. Hop on and let's get started!
